title: The To-Do List Trap
logline: Max has 47 tasks. Priya has a chart. Grandma Lin has a better idea.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: Good morning. I have forty seven tasks today.

lines.speaker: priya_lead
lines.text: Forty seven? That is not a list. That is a novel.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: I will just start with the easy ones.

lines.speaker: priya_lead
lines.text: Classic mistake. Easy tasks feel great. They change nothing.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: But I answered twelve emails!

lines.speaker: priya_lead
lines.text: And the bug from Monday?

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: It is still. Emotionally. In progress.

lines.speaker: grandma_lin
lines.text: In my day, we had one task. Build the bridge.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: Grandma Lin? Since when are you here?

lines.speaker: grandma_lin
lines.text: Since nineteen seventy one. I am always here.

lines.speaker: priya_lead
lines.text: Let me show you the data. Look at this chart.

lines.speaker: priya_lead
lines.text: One hard task in the morning. Huge progress.

lines.speaker: priya_lead
lines.text: Forty small tasks. Tiny progress. Big tiredness.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: So the list is lying to me?

lines.speaker: grandma_lin
lines.text: The list is not lying. You are hiding behind it.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: Wow. That was very personal.

lines.speaker: grandma_lin
lines.text: Step one. Pick the scary task.

lines.speaker: grandma_lin
lines.text: Step two. Do it before you open your inbox.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: Before the inbox? That is illegal.

lines.speaker: priya_lead
lines.text: It is not illegal. It is just uncomfortable.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: Fine. The scary task is the Monday bug.

lines.speaker: priya_lead
lines.text: How long will it take?

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: Between ten minutes and the rest of my life.

lines.speaker: grandma_lin
lines.text: Then set a timer. Ninety minutes. No phone.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: No phone? What if something happens?

lines.speaker: priya_lead
lines.text: Something will happen. Your work.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: Okay. Timer on. Phone in the drawer.

lines.speaker: grandma_lin
lines.text: Good. Now the small tasks go in one batch. After lunch.

lines.speaker: priya_lead
lines.text: Emails, messages, meetings. One block. Done.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: Wait. I fixed it. The bug is gone!

lines.speaker: priya_lead
lines.text: In how long?

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: Eleven minutes.

lines.speaker: grandma_lin
lines.text: Eleven minutes. After three days of avoiding it.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: I feel betrayed by my own brain.

lines.speaker: priya_lead
lines.text: Welcome to productivity.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: So what do I do with the other forty six tasks?

lines.speaker: grandma_lin
lines.text: Delete half. Nobody will notice.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: Is that true?

lines.speaker: grandma_lin
lines.text: I deleted my calendar in two thousand five. Still alive.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: Repeat? Every day? Forever?

lines.speaker: priya_lead
lines.text: Only on days you want things done.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: That is most days. Unfortunately.

lines.speaker: grandma_lin
lines.text: Here is the secret. Start before you feel ready.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: I never feel ready.

lines.speaker: grandma_lin
lines.text: Perfect. Then you can start any time.

lines.speaker: priya_lead
lines.text: And when you finish the scary task, celebrate.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: With coffee?

lines.speaker: priya_lead
lines.text: With one coffee. Not four.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: Three. Final offer.

lines.speaker: grandma_lin
lines.text: Two. And you clean my keyboard.

lines.speaker: max_dev
lines.text: Deal. Step four. Bribe Grandma Lin.

lines.speaker: priya_lead
lines.text: Step five. Tomorrow, repeat.
